questsForChains.title: Byblos I — the souk
questsForChains.description: Find the oldest shop still trading in the souk and get the owner to tell you how long they have been there.

questsForChains.title: Byblos II — the castle
questsForChains.description: From the keep you can see every layer of the city at once. Photograph the Phoenician, Roman and Crusader work in a single frame.

questsForChains.title: Byblos III — the port
questsForChains.description: Cedar left for Egypt from this harbour. Find a fisherman who will tell you what leaves from it now.

questsForChains.title: Relay I — start the story
questsForChains.description: Film ten seconds that begin a story, ending on a gesture the next person must pick up. Hand it on.

questsForChains.title: Relay II — continue it
questsForChains.description: Start your ten seconds on exactly the gesture the last person ended on, somewhere they have never been.

questsForChains.title: Relay III — land it
questsForChains.description: Close the story. Same rule: begin where the last one ended.

questsForChains.title: Levant table — Lebanon
questsForChains.description: Bring the bread. Film someone in Tripoli making it the way they always have.

questsForChains.title: Levant table — Palestine
questsForChains.description: Bring the oil. Film an olive press in the hills around Sebastia and ask how old the trees are.

questsForChains.title: Levant table — Qatar
questsForChains.description: Bring the coffee. Film gahwa poured properly in Souq Waqif and learn what the cardamom is for.

questsForChains.title: Find the sea gate
questsForChains.description: Photograph the arch the boats came through, from the inside.

questsForChains.title: Find the merchants gate
questsForChains.description: Stand where the caravans were counted and show the groove the carts wore into the stone.

questsForChains.title: Find the gate that was walled up
questsForChains.description: One gate was sealed. Show the outline still visible in the masonry.

questsForChains.title: The well they still use
questsForChains.description: Photograph the rope groove worn into the stone lip.

questsForChains.title: The well they filled in
questsForChains.description: Find the circle in the paving where a well used to be.

questsForChains.title: The well nobody will point to
questsForChains.description: Ask three people. One of them knows.

chains.name: Byblos in three acts
chains.description: Souk, castle, port — each one opens the next.

chains.name: Pass it on
chains.description: Three people, one continuous story. Nobody can start until the person before them is approved.

chains.name: One table, three countries
chains.description: Bread from Lebanon, oil from Palestine, coffee from Qatar. Any order — the table is only finished when all three arrive.

chains.name: The three gates of the old city
chains.description: Three gates, three eras, one wall.
